items.text_th: เล่นสนุกเจอเพื่อนเยอะเล่นมาหลายปีเเล้ว
items.text_vn: Chơi vui, gặp nhiều bạn bè, chơi mấy năm rồi.
items.theme: Tương tác xã hội tiêu cực
items.summary_vn: Khen game vui, gặp nhiều bạn, đã chơi nhiều năm
items.text_vn_machine: Phản hồi tích cực về tương tác cộng đồng hoặc hành vi người chơi. Đây là tóm tắt phân loại; cần đối chiếu nguyên văn tiếng Thái.
items.text_en: Fun to play, met lots of friends, been playing for years.
items.summary_en: Says the game is fun, met many friends, played for years.

items.text_th: เกมแบนมั่วนะครับ แอปนี้ไม่มีให้เติมคูปองในแอป และไม่สามรถซื้อ play tube แบบแอปแรกได้ ควรทำให้ได้เหมือนแอปแรกด้วยนะครับ ผู้เล่นสามารถเห็นถึงความต่างของแอปได้ครับ แฮกเกอร์ที่แฮกเกมไม่แบน มาแบนคนเล่นปกติ ผมเล่นเกมอื่นไม่เคยโดนแบนนะ ถ้าตัวเกมมีปัญหาควรแก้ไขที่เกมครับไม่ใช่มาแบนคนเล่นแบบปกติ
items.text_vn: Game ban bừa bãi. App này không cho nạp coupon trong app, cũng không mua được Play Tube như app đầu. Nên làm được giống app đầu nhé. Người chơi thấy rõ sự khác biệt giữa hai app. Hacker hack game thì không ban, lại đi ban người chơi bình thường. Tôi chơi game khác chưa từng bị ban. Nếu game có vấn đề thì nên sửa ở game chứ đừng đi ban người chơi bình thường.
items.summary_vn: Phàn nàn ban nhầm người chơi thường, không nạp coupon, mua Play Tube được.
items.text_en: The game bans randomly. This app doesn't let you redeem coupons in-app, and you can't buy Play Tube like in the first app. Please make it like the first app. Players can clearly see the difference between the two apps. Hackers don't get banned, but normal players do. I've never been banned in other games. If the game has problems, fix the game, don't ban normal players.
items.summary_en: Complains normal players get wrongly banned; can't redeem coupons or buy Play Tube.
Says the game is really fun.

items.text_th: เกมส์ดีมาก พัฒนาต่อไปนะค่ะ 𐔌՞ ܸ.ˬ.ܸ ՞𐦯
items.text_vn: Game rất hay, tiếp tục phát triển nha 𐔌՞ ܸ.ˬ.ܸ ՞𐦯
items.summary_vn: Khen game hay, mong tiếp tục phát triển.
items.text_en: Great game, keep it up 𐔌՞ ܸ.ˬ.ܸ ՞𐦯
items.summary_en: Says the game is great and hopes it keeps improving.

items.text_th: บอกตรงๆนะปัญหาเดิมเลยเกมจะเจ๊งเพราะคุณไม่แก้ไขปัญหาบอท คือบอท วาร์ปมาเก็บ การ์ดต่อหน้าทั้งๆที่เราวิ่งเล่นเกมตั้งใจทำกิจกรรมบอทวิ่งมาชิงต่อหน้า ทั้งๆที่เขาไม่ได้ทำอะไรเลยแล้วเอาบัตรที่ได้เนี่ยไปขายเพื่อทำกำไรแล้วคนที่ตั้งใจเล่นจริงๆอ่ะเขาจะมีกำลังใจเล่นหรออยากให้ปรับปรุงบ้างแก้ไขหน่อยรับฟัง
items.text_vn: Nói thẳng nhé, vẫn là vấn đề cũ, game sẽ sập vì các bạn không xử lý vấn đề bot. Bot dịch chuyển tới nhặt thẻ ngay trước mặt, trong khi mình chạy chơi chăm chỉ làm hoạt động thì bot lao tới giành ngay trước mặt, dù họ chẳng làm gì cả, rồi đem thẻ nhặt được đi bán kiếm lời. Vậy người chơi thật sự chăm chỉ thì còn động lực mà chơi không? Mong cải thiện, sửa đi, lắng nghe chút đi.
items.theme: Tương tác xã hội tiêu cực
items.summary_vn: Bot dịch chuyển giành nhặt thẻ để bán, yêu cầu xử lý.
items.text_en: I'll be blunt, it's the same old problem: the game will die because you don't deal with bots. Bots teleport in and grab cards right in front of me. I'm running around working hard doing activities, and the bots rush in and snatch them right in front of me, even though they do nothing, then sell the cards for profit. So what motivation do hard-working real players have left? Please improve this, fix it, listen a little.
items.summary_en: Teleporting bots snatch cards to sell; asks for action.

items.text_th: อัปเดตเกมไม่ได้ควรทำอย่างไรกดอัปเดตไม่ได้เลย
items.text_vn: Không cập nhật game được, phải làm sao? Bấm cập nhật mà không được luôn.
items.summary_vn: Không bấm cập nhật game được, hỏi cách xử lý.
items.text_en: Can't update the game, what do I do? I tap update and nothing happens.
items.summary_en: Update button doesn't work; asks how to fix it.

items.text_th: เกมน่าเบื่อใครไม่มีเงินอย่าเล่นของแพงมากอะไรก็เป็นเงินไปหมดปลายักก็ตกยากไม่ค่อยออกโปรก็เยอะวาปไปมา เครือข่ายก็ไม่เสถียรกว่าจะเข้าเกมได้แต่ละที ใส่โค้ดก็ลำบากหนีไปหาเกมอื่นเล่นเถอะ
items.text_vn: Game chán, ai không có tiền thì đừng chơi. Đồ đắt lắm, cái gì cũng phải tốn tiền hết. Cá khổng lồ thì khó câu, hiếm khi ra. Hack (?) cũng nhiều, dịch chuyển tới lui. Mạng cũng không ổn định, mỗi lần vào được game là cả một quá trình. Nhập code cũng khó khăn. Đi tìm game khác mà chơi đi.
items.summary_vn: Đồ quá đắt, cá khổng lồ khó câu, nhiều hack, mạng kém.
items.text_en: Boring game, don't play if you don't have money. Items are really expensive, everything costs money. Giant fish are hard to catch and rarely show up. Lots of hackers (?) too, teleporting around. The connection isn't stable either, getting into the game is a whole process every time. Entering codes is a pain too. Go find another game to play.
items.summary_en: Items too expensive, giant fish hard to catch, many hackers, poor connection.

items.text_th: ทำไมถึงเล่นไม่ได้สลับตัวที่รู้ว่าเป็นอะไร. แย่มาก
items.text_vn: Sao không chơi được, không đổi nhân vật được, chẳng biết bị gì. Tệ quá.
items.summary_vn: Không chơi được, không đổi nhân vật được.
items.text_en: Why can't I play, can't switch characters, no idea what's wrong. So bad.
items.summary_en: Can't play and can't switch characters.
